checklist: The first entry into Edit after launch, through the page's own step (⌘3), not lumina.edit: the canvas gets the photo and the page's first look, the frame for that look is acknowledged (luminaPresented), and the footer leaves 'rendering…'. Then Pick → Edit again, and the next photo. Folder: LUMINA_EDIT_DIR (probe.sh scenarios sets it).

steps.src: window.__edit=()=>{const el=document.querySelector('[data-lumina="canvas"]');if(!el)return null;const k=Object.keys(el).find(x=>x.startsWith('__reactFiber$'));for(let f=el[k];f;f=f.return){const sn=f.stateNode;if(sn&&sn.logic&&typeof sn.logic.nbInfo==='function')return sn.logic;}return null;};window.__first=()=>lumina.edit.stats().then(s=>{const E=__edit(),i=E?E.nbInfo():null,st=lumina.edit.state();return JSON.stringify({view:__probe.logic().state.view,rel:st.rel,path:st.path,visible:st.visible,rect:st.rect,page:i&&{seq:i.seq,shown:i.shown,pending:i.pending,fallback:i.fallback,facts:i.facts},rendering:!!document.querySelector('[data-lumina="rendering"]'),mac:{rel:s.rel,visible:s.visible,canvas:s.canvas,renders:s.renders,errors:s.renderErrors,facts:s.facts&&s.facts.text,source:s.bases&&s.bases.lastSource,submitted:s.schedule&&s.schedule.submitted}});});return luminaStep('edit')

steps.what: the canvas drew the photo on the first entry
first entry: the page's look is on screen and the footer is not on rendering…
first entry: the footer has the canvas facts and the page does not draw its own preview
second entry: the page's look is on screen
second entry: the footer has the canvas facts again
the next photo is on the canvas and its look acknowledged
next photo: the page's look is on screen
